item.title: Glido 1.2.0
item.description:
• Backgrounds: macOS wallpapers, gradients, colours or your own image, with padding, corners, shadow and frames
  • Mask: blur, pixelate or highlight any part of the screen for as long as you need, right on the preview
  • Find private details: Glido reads your recording on your Mac and hides emails, API keys, card and phone numbers for you
  • Crop the recording, with presets and a one-click "No menu bar"
  • Video shapes: wide, square, classic, vertical, tall and portrait
  • A bigger preview, a cleaner top bar and one consistent look across the app
  • New timeline blocks for zooms, camera layouts and masks
  • Exports open in a small panel with a picture of each export, and tell you when one is older than your edits

item.title: Glido 1.1.0
item.description:
• Your camera in the video: a soft 3D camera slot, nine spots, shapes and sizes; turn it on or off from any recording toolbar and drag the bubble out of your way
  • Camera layouts along the timeline: full screen, split, side by side, hidden, presenter, sticker and cutout, with smooth changes between them
  • Cutouts remove your background right on your Mac, live while you edit
  • Cut tool: press C, click to cut, remove pieces, drag an edge to trim or bring footage back
  • Zoom track: add a zoom anywhere, move it, resize it, change its level
  • Smoother automatic zooms and a smoother cursor
  • Zoom into the timeline with the slider, a pinch or ⌘ + scroll
  • Microphone and Mac sound, each on its own track with volume and mute
  • Record a single window or an area of the screen

item.title: Glido 1.0.3
item.description:
• New recorder: a blue timer in the menu bar, with a live preview, Pause, Start over and Discard
  • Or a slim floating bar on the left edge that you can drag, or shrink to a dot
  • A 3, 2, 1 countdown before recording (can be turned off)
  • Settings now live in the Glido window: General, Recording, License, Updates, About
  • Trials start at checkout: monthly and yearly plans are free for 7 days
  • Glido opens the Library every time you start it; full screen no longer leaves a gap

item.title: Glido 1.0.2
item.description:
• The Library and your recordings now share one window: open a recording and go back with ‹ Library (⌘L)
  • Glido stays in the Dock and ⌘-Tab until you quit it; click the Dock icon to open the Library
  • The green window button goes full screen
  • Glido › Settings… (⌘,) opens Glido's settings

item.title: Glido 1.0.1
item.description:
• Updates now open in Glido's own window with what's new, and never interrupt a recording
  • Settings › Updates shows where an update is: checking, downloading or ready to install
  • Settings, Unlock and Setup windows fit their content, with no empty space at the bottom

item.title: Glido 1.0.0
item.description:
• Record your screen with ⌘⇧2 and get a polished video that zooms in on every click by itself
  • Turn the same recording into an interactive demo people click through, with tooltips and step descriptions
  • Edit demo steps: wording, descriptions, blurs, intro and ending cards
  • Export MP4 (1080p or 4K), GIF, or a demo you can host anywhere; every export is kept, never overwritten
  • The Library keeps projects, folders and exports together, and tells you when an export is out of date
